== Title ==
<span lang="ja">いやな予感がするぜ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">いやな予感がしようとも、戦闘力の合計が相手より少ないロケーションで戦闘を宣言すること。負ければ何も起こらない。勝てば、相手の失うフォースは2倍になる（ハンがいれば3倍になる）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">コーポレート セクターや ハット スペースでの冒険で ハンは何度も窮地に追い込まれた。そして 今また…</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[I've Got A Bad Feeling About This]].

'''Lore''' — Han's adventures in the Corporate Sector and Hutt Space drove him into tight spots many times. And now again…

'''Game text''' — Even with a bad feeling, initiate a battle at a location where your total power is less than the opponent's. If you lose, nothing happens. If you win, the opponent's Force loss is doubled (tripled if Han is present).

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore names 冒険 rather than smuggling adventures.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-ivegotabadfeelingaboutthis-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[I've Got A Bad Feeling About This]].</ref>
